CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR ELECTION

A motion was made by Vice Chair Ross, to elect Member Cruz for Chair of the Transactions
and Use Tax Citizens' Advisory Committee. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  4  Cruz, Emigh, Hower, Ross
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  0  None

A motion was made by Member Cruz, to elect Member Emigh for Vice Chair of the
Transactions and Use Tax Citizens' Advisory Committee. The motion carried by the following
vote:

Yes:  4  Cruz, Emigh, Hower, Ross
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  0  None

Vice Chair Ross spoke.

Nader Kaamoush, Budget Management Officer, Financial Management, spoke.

Member Emigh spoke.

Member Cruz spoke.

Vanessa Ibarra, Deputy City Attorney, spoke.

Vice Chair Ross declared the nominations open for Chair.

Vice Chair Ross nominated Member Cruz as Chair of the Transactions and Use Tax Citizens’
Advisory Committee.

There being no further nominations, Vice Chair Ross declared the nominations closed for Chair.

Member Cruz accepted the Chair of the Transactions and Use Tax Citizens’ Advisory
Committee nomination.
